Vantage Cloud Careers

Senior Backend Engineer — Payments

Vantage Cloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own our payments processing platform. You will design and operate the services that move money for thousands of merchants every day, working closely with product and compliance teams.

Required

  • 5+ years building backend services in a high-availability production environment
  • Experience with distributed transactions and idempotent payment processing
  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills

Responsibilities

  • Own the reliability and correctness of the core payments ledger
  • Design APIs consumed by internal billing and external partner systems
  • Mentor engineers and drive incident postmortems to completion
